earlier_sources: https://github.com/cyrealtype/Iceland at bb43144b50825221060747ddba7b23bc05e7c960: src/Iceland-Regular-TTF.vfb, a FontLab import of the TrueType font, and src/Iceland-Regular-OTF.vfb, one of the OpenType font.
disclose: The release carries a `PCLT` table (HP PCL 5 printer metrics; the OpenType specification says its use is strongly discouraged). fontc writes none, and no renderer reads it, so the build has no `PCLT`. Kept and disclosed.
